title: Container types
purpose: Maintain box grids: rows, columns, position labels and numbering. A grid change is a new version, so existing boxes keep their positions.
summary: Box grids: rows, columns, position labels and numbering. A grid change is a new version, so existing boxes keep their positions.

tasks.title: Add a box grid
steps: Admin and manager: select [[New container type]].

tasks.title: Change a grid
steps: Open the version and select New version. Existing boxes keep the old grid.

good_to_know: All versions are listed unless you choose a [[Status]].
Inactive versions stay on existing boxes but cannot be chosen for new boxes.
Boxes counts active boxes using that version.

sections.title: Search, filters and sorting
paragraphs: Search matches part of the code or name, ignoring capitals.
All versions are listed, active and inactive, unless a status is chosen. Sorting by code keeps versions together, oldest first.
Click a sortable column heading to sort by it; click again to reverse. Ties keep a stable order. Choose 25, 50 or 100 rows per page; the default is 25.

items.label: Status
items.description: Active and inactive (the default), Active, or Inactive.

items.label: Code
items.description: Code shared by all versions of the type; opens that version. Always shown.

items.label: Version
items.description: Version number; a new version of an existing code gets the next number.

items.label: Boxes
items.description: Number of active boxes using this version. Sortable.

items.label: Status
items.description: Active, or Inactive: inactive versions stay on existing boxes but cannot be chosen for new boxes.

items.label: Export CSV
items.description: Downloads the rows that match the current search, filters and sort as a UTF-8 CSV file. Any role that can read this list can download it. A selection of more than 10,000 rows is refused rather than cut short: narrow the filters and export again. Cells that a spreadsheet could read as a formula are prefixed with an apostrophe, and numbers are exact decimals. Each download is recorded in the audit trail with who exported which selection and how many rows, never the file itself.

items.label: New container type
items.description: Opens the create form. Shown only to the admin and manager roles.

items.label: No records yet
items.description: Shown when nothing has been defined. Users who may create records see the create button in the message.

items.label: Nothing matches these filters
items.description: The search or filters exclude every row. Change or clear them.

items.label: These filters cannot be applied
items.description: A filter value was not valid. The list shows no rows rather than all rows; correct the highlighted filter.
